claim_scores.rationale: Patches `litellm.responses`, captures kwargs in `fake_responses`, and invokes `dspy.LM(..., model_type='responses')`, so it inspects the post-conversion outbound request.
`fake_responses` returns `FakeResponsesResp`, a response-like object with the fields needed for the call to complete without a real request.
Defines `AnswerModel` as a `pydantic.BaseModel` subclass and passes it via `lm.forward(..., response_format=AnswerModel)` while using `model_type='responses'`.
Asserts `"response_format" not in call`, directly checking the captured payload omits a top-level `response_format` field.
Asserts the schema is under `call["text"]["format"]` with `name == "AnswerModel"`, `type == "json_schema"`, and expected schema properties from the Pydantic model.
